scripts.build: rm -rf build && mkdir build && yarn build:css && cp -r html css img fonts js _locales manifest.json build/ && rm -rf build/img/src
scripts.build:store: yarn build && node -e "const f='build/manifest.json',m=require('./'+f);m.permissions=m.permissions.filter(p=>p!=='userScripts');require('fs').writeFileSync(f,JSON.stringify(m,null,2))" && rm -f alibi-store.zip && cd build && zip -qr ../alibi-store.zip .
